questions.question: What are the three phases of this Python course?
questions.explanation: The course is organized into Phase 1 (Fundamentals: Modules 1-10), Phase 2 (Intermediate: Modules 11-15), and Phase 3 (Projects: Modules 16-20). This structured approach guides you from beginner to building real applications.

questions.question: When does a module quiz become available?
options: After completing all lessons in the module
It's always available from the start
questions.explanation: The module quiz unlocks only after you've completed all lessons within that module. This ensures you've learned all the necessary concepts before being tested on them.

questions.question: What do XP points represent?
options: Experience Points - earned for completing lessons
Example Programs - sample code to study
Expertise Points - measure of Python knowledge
questions.explanation: XP stands for Experience Points. You earn XP by completing lessons, exercises, and quizzes. They gamify your learning journey and help track your progress through the course.

questions.question: What can you do with completed lessons in Review Mode?
options: Only view them but not edit code
Revisit, practice exercises again, and retake quizzes
Convert them into different programming languages
questions.explanation: Review Mode lets you revisit any completed lesson to reinforce learning. You can re-read content, redo exercises for practice, and retake quizzes to improve your understanding without affecting your original progress.
